title: The 9 Times Table Trick Using Just Your Fingers
description: A simple, beginner-friendly trick for multiplying by 9 — no memorizing required, just your ten fingers. Great for anyone starting to learn multiplication tables.
narration_lines: Multiplying by 9? There's a trick for that, using just your fingers.
Hold up both hands. Ten fingers, numbered 1 to 10.
Let's try 9 times 4. Fold down finger number 4.
Count the fingers before the fold, and the fingers after it.
Put those two counts side by side. 3 and 6 makes 36.
And that's it. 9 times 4 really is 36. Try it with any number from 1 to 10.
